description: An Axum-based Rust web framework with Lean 4-verifiable application kernels that run on servers, bare-metal embedded devices, and GPUs, plus integrated security testing.

written.description: Gives an agent a browser that controls its own network traffic, so the model can capture, edit, replay and compare the requests a web app sends without a proxy in between. Each session runs under a network policy and records every fetch it allowed or refused.

alive.last_commit_message:
h5i-app-h1: independent head spec, soundness, stricter target and Host (#801)

* h5i-app-h1: independent head spec, soundness, stricter target and Host

- Origin-form target: "/" then pchar, "/", "?" and %HEXDIG HEXDIG only (no "#").
- Host value: empty or uri-host [":" port]; invalid is 400.
- H1Valid.lean: ValidHead and framing (RFC 9112 6.3) with their own byte
  classes, lowercasing and literals, importing nothing from the parser spec.
- H1Sound.lean: parse_head_sound, every accepted head is a ValidHead with
  H1Valid.framing and matching spans. The same bug planted in Rust and
  H1Spec (case-sensitive lower, off-by-one hex, wrong TE literal) now fails.
- no_smuggling_valid: the lenient family reads names via H1Valid, and the
  framing it agrees on is H1Valid.framing.
- README: the grammar is a subset that rejects some valid requests.

* h5i-app-cli: mutate keeps a root crate's own manifest

When the kernel crate is the project root (as h5i-app-h1 is), the sandbox
anchor was the crate itself, so the copied workspace Cargo.toml overwrote the
crate's. The anchor now moves up past any crate directory.

* h5i-app-h1: independent chunked grammar and its soundness

- H1Valid: ValidChunked (RFC 9112 7.1, 1 to 8 hex digits, no extensions or
  trailers, payload at most max_body) with its own hex values.
- H1Chunked: dechunk_valid, read_body_chunked_valid, recv_step_chunked_valid:
  every accepted chunked body is a ValidChunked, rx[start..used] is that body
  and rx[start..end] its payload. An off-by-one hex value or a wrong total
  check planted in both Rust and the spec now fails.

* h5i-app-h1: prove whole response heads with extra fields

- write_head_with (write_head_open, write_fields, end_head) replaces the
  field loop in h5i-app-embedded. Fields are a fixed array of
  MAX_EXTRA_FIELDS plus a count, written without a loop, since Aeneas
  cannot extract a slice or index an array of borrowed slices.
- H1Fields: write_fields_spec, write_head_with_spec, write_head_with_total:
  on Some(p) every field written passed write_field's checks and out starts
  with exactly Spec.renderHeadWith of them.
- h5i-app-embedded: filled.saturating_add(n); the read gets only
  rx[filled..], and a count past the end gives filled > rx.len(), which
  recv_step answers with 500. README says so instead of "not proven".
